name: Christs Return
overview: Scripture reveals that Christ's return will be sudden and unexpected, as no one knows the exact day or hour except the Father, emphasizing the need for constant readiness. Jesus himself warned His disciples to be prepared, for the Son of Man will come at an hour they do not anticipate. This second coming will be distinct from His first, appearing without sin to bring salvation to those who eagerly await Him. At His return, Christ will bring rewards according to each person's deeds, underscoring the importance of faithful living in anticipation of His coming.
